recent.text: The #mnwild moves to 17-3-5 with tonight’s 4-3 SOL and leads the NHL with 39 pts, the most in team history through 25 games. Minnesota extends its point streak to 14 games (12-0-2), tying the team record, and its road point streak to 10 games (9-0-1), 4th-longest in team history.
recent.author: Aaron Sickman

recent.text: The #mnwild moves to 17-3-5 on the season and leads the NHL with 39 points, the highest mark in franchise history after 25 games. Minnesota extends its current point streak to 14 games (11-0-3), tying the franchise record set in the 2022-23 season (11-0-3, 2/17-3/25/23).
recent.author: Minnesota Wild PR

recent.text: Wild’s 9-game road win streak ends but they tie their franchise record overall point streak (11-0-3). 14-game point streak for Kaprizov. Vancouver has beaten Vegas, Utah and now Minnesota in 3 of its past 4 games
recent.author: Michael Russo

recent.text: The #mnwild falls 4-3 following the shootout in Vancouver. Matt Boldy, Jared Spurgeon and Nick Foligno scored, while Jesper Wallstedt stopped 21-of-24 shots faced.
recent.author: Minnesota Wild PR

recent.text: #mnwild lose in shootout 4-3. Still extend their point streak to 14 games (11-0-3). Will face San Jose to end trip on Monday
